To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
COBE is an ontology search tool with a novel NE mode that can help users navigate to specific concept clusters, and an improved DL mode that can help find specific concepts.

COBE is able to: 1) provide a novel conjunctive search mode for exploring SNOMED concepts, and 2) achieve high performance in terms of precision, recall and F1 measure in the DL mode, and 3) achieve high recall in terms of the number of concepts covered by the navigational search mode.

COBE attaining an example-based precision, recall, and F1 of 0.96, 0.91, and 0.88 respectively for the DL mode, and that COBE leveraging only 9.37 percent of the entire stem cloud to cover 98.97 percent of all SNOMED CT terms for the NE mode.
